tools.name: verify_delivery_receipt
tools.description: Proof of delivery check. Verifies a delivery receipt: the seller's signature over the deliverable hash (SHA-256) and, if present, the buyer's countersignature. Returns countersigned, seller-only or invalid, with reasons. Optionally compares a file's SHA-256 with the deliverable hash. Relevant to a d

tools.name: lookup_delivery_receipt
tools.description: Finds countersigned receipts in the public log by receipt ID, deliverable hash (file SHA-256) or seller key. Shows a seller's published proof of delivery history. The log only holds receipts that a seller or buyer chose to publish, and a key is not a verified identity.

tools.name: log_stats
tools.description: Counts from the public log of countersigned receipts: receipts, distinct seller keys, distinct buyer keys and distinct seller-buyer pairs. Receipts the Wayreceipt team made for testing and removed entries are not counted.

tools.name: publish_delivery_receipt
tools.description: Publishes a countersigned receipt (already signed by both seller and buyer) to the public log, as lasting proof of delivery for a deliverable hash. Signing happens on your side with the free library; this server never holds keys. The server re-verifies the receipt and rejects seller-only or invalid
